name: mictrack_mt700
description: MicTrack's protocol is text, not AVL numbering.

event.name: Event
event.description: The reason for the report, sent on every message form the MT600 uses (R0 location, R1/R2/R3/R12/R13 network, RH status). `event` is on the built-in denylist because other protocols put an unbounded blob there; here it is a small integer, and an override beats the denylist, which is what a model profile is for. The six labels are the codes MictrackProtocolDecoder.decodeAlarm maps to alarms and the only ones Traccar documents; anything else keeps showing as its number, so a firmware that adds one is not hidden.

type.name: Message type
type.description: KEY_TYPE, the counter MicTrack puts in field 2 of every sentence. Useful when reading a capture, not on a dashboard, so it is created switched off.
